scope: Japan domestic AI system development; APPClient mobile views for customers and internally authorized providers
constraints: Only development service is available in V1.
Human compliance review and technical clarification must pass before hall publication.
Customers may view their own unapproved requests; unapproved requests never appear in the hall.
Internal account authorization is distinct from future OPC certification.
Task consultation CTA does not determine claiming or assignment policy.
Deliverables undergo internal review before customer-facing publication.
Acceptance does not imply payment, settlement, or escrow.
Use distinct request IDs for examples at different lifecycle stages.
Design with editable native layers and verify Japanese text and actual rendered layout.
